scene: You step off the hillside chairlift onto the breezy, grassy hilltop.
picture: A flat side view along a grassy ridge. Far left sits the wooden chairlift station beside fluttering striped wind socks. The boy with black hair, orange vest, white scarf, and strapped kite stands left. In the centre, a girl holds a dragon kite spool. Far right sits a steaming wooden tea hut with open door.
shown: a row of striped wind socks fluttering on poles on the far left
a wooden tea hut with steaming chimney standing on the right
a smiling girl holding a huge dragon kite spool in the centre

variants.scene: The evening breeze ruffles your scarf as the lift delivers you to the ridge.
Fresh alpine air greets you on the grassy bluff under a purple sky.
You arrive at the scenic hilltop, still wondering where to search for {quest}.
